goals: Verify that the HTTP request to the target URL returns a successful status code (2xx).
Ensure the failure rate of HTTP requests is below 1%.
Ensure 95% of HTTP requests complete within 500ms.
activities: Initialize test configuration parameters (target URL, HTTP method, request body, headers, stages, VUs, duration) from environment variables or default values.
Parse headers and stages configuration from JSON strings.
Conditionally set 'Content-Type: application/json' header for requests with a body and specific HTTP methods if not already present.
Configure k6 test options including execution stages, virtual users, duration, and performance thresholds.
Prepare HTTP request parameters, including headers, for the current iteration.
Send an HTTP request to the target URL with the specified method, body, and parameters.
Verify that the HTTP response status code is within the 2xx range.
